Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to extract the correct death place from the ThePeerage page it was viewing. While the Wikipedia page clearly listed "Weston-under-Lizard" as the death place, the WebSurfer incorrectly reported the death place as "Weston Park" based on the ThePeerage page. Weston Park is the family seat (estate) mentioned in the text, not the specific town where the death occurred. The agent confused the location of the estate with the location of death, leading to an incorrect final answer ("Weston Park" instead of "Weston-under-Lizard"). This is a data extraction error where the agent misinterpreted the context of the information on the page.
